evidence.quote:
To address the problem of system voltage instability 
caused by photovoltaic current injection during faults, this 
paper proposes a static voltage stability analysis and control 
strategy for distribution networks during faults. The 
following conclusions are obtained through simulation 
verification: 
(1) The large access capacity of distributed photovoltaic 
power and the long electrical distance between the 
distribution network and the AC power supply are the main 
factors leading to static voltage instability during faults. 
(2) The strategy proposed in this paper calculates the 
output Angle range of the photovoltaic current under the 
condition of voltage stability during the fault period, and 
then corrects the current reference value of the low -
penetration strategy, which can effectively improve the static 
voltage stability during the fault ride-through period. 
Compared with the classic low -voltage ride -through 
control strategy, the strategy proposed in this paper has a 
smaller computational load and does not require significant 
modifications to the photovoltaic control structure, thus 
having stronger applicability.
evidence.interpretation: 故障期间按电流角范围修正LVRT参考值；已读范围未展示独立多有功组合空间与进出序列。

If the capacity of RES is not
large enough, (set to 2.0 pu in this case), then the RES will
switch before the operating point reaches the saddle point. In
Fig. 2, when the operating point reaches the mode switching
point, as the load impedance decreases, the operating point
will shift from the PV curve in constant voltage control mode
to the PV curve in constant current control mode. If the load
impedance continues to decrease, the system operating point
will move toward the origin along the PV curve in constant
current control mode. In this case, the load limit of the system
is not at the saddle point, but at the mode switching point. If
the capacity of the RES is large enough (set to 5.0 pu in this
case), then the PV curve in constant current control mode will
be below the saddle point. As the load impedance decreases,
the operating point of the system will ﬁrst reach the saddle
point, and then reach the control mode switching point after
crossing the saddle point. In this case, the load limit of the
system is still at the saddle point.

paper compares the following three scenarios: 
Scenario 1: The VSC -HVDC system provides only active 
power support.

power support.

active and reactive power control.

P0=0.8S, Q0=0. When the VSC -HVDC system provides only 
active power support, the reactive power remains at the initial 
state Q0, with the available active power support ranging from 
-0.8S to 0.2S. When the system provides only reactive power 
support, the active power remains at the initial state P0, with the 
available reactive power support ranging from -0.6S to 0.6S. 
When the VSC -HVDC system provides both active and 
reactive power support, the available active power support 
ranges from -0.8S to 0.2S, and the available reactive power 
support ranges from -S to S. The allowable voltage range at the 
AC system nodes is 0.9 pu to 1.1 pu. 
For the PSO algorithm, the swarm size is set to 500 particles, 
with a maximum of 200 iterations. Table  II shows the L index 
of the system after applying the power support under the three 
scenarios.

evidence.quote:
尽管本文取得了一定成果，但仍有以下潜在方
向值得进一步探索：1）考虑大扰动下暂态稳定等
更加复杂的系统动态约束， 提升所得新能源承载方
案的安全稳定水平；2）计及多类型新能源出力 波
动的时空相关性，从而有效获取兼顾系统安全稳定
风险与运行效益的新型电力系统新能源规划方案。
evidence.interpretation: 作者后续考虑暂态约束及多类新能源时空相关波动。

evidence.quote:
需要特别指出的是，本节算例显示 Q-V 下垂控
制的承载能力略低于定 PQ 控制，这并非意味着下
垂控制策略本身存在机理上的缺陷，而是受限于固
定参数配置的工程化设定。具体而言，方案 3 为了
模拟工程中常见的低通信依赖和本地化运维场景，
下垂控制采用了固定参数设置模式(即 Qref=0)，此
时逆变器输出的无功功率 完全由其端电压与 参考
电压的偏差乘以下垂系数决定，缺乏主动优化的自
由度。在系统接近静态电压稳定极限时，尽管端电
压有所下降，但只要其与参考电压的偏差不大，逆
变器提供的无功支撑就十分有限，小于功率因数约
束下的无功上限。
evidence.interpretation: 下垂容量结果受固定参数和自由度限制，不能归因为下垂机理差。
